en-US.description: Automated Movie, TV Show, Game, Anime & Music Folder Icon Customizer with IMDb ratings.
en-US.longDescription: FoliCon is a Windows folder icon customizer for movies, TV series, anime, games, and music. It automatically searches online metadata providers (TMDB, IGDB, DeviantArt), fetches high-resolution poster art and ratings, and generates stylized Windows folder icons with custom overlays.
en-US.name: FoliCon
